entities.summary: Calvin Eugene Garrett is an American retired National Basketball Association (NBA) basketball player. He played three seasons with the Houston Rockets and one with the Los Angeles Lakers (1983–84). He played in college at Oral Roberts University in Tulsa, Oklahoma.
